description: A2A Agent Gateway — relay server + client for cross-network agent discovery and communication. Server mode accepts WebSocket connections from remote agents; client mode connects to a relay server to make this instance discoverable.
author: tianshu-ai

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: off: disabled. client: connect to a remote relay. server: act as a relay gateway.

fields.label: Relay Server URL
fields.description: WebSocket URL of the relay server (client mode only), e.g. wss://hub.example.com/ws

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key for authenticating with the relay server (client mode only)

fields.label: Discoverable
fields.description: Whether this agent appears in the relay's public discovery list

fields.label: Server Port
fields.description: Port for the relay server (server mode only)
